name: Contract / Negotiation Call
description: Document vendor contract discussions, procurement negotiations, and agreement reviews including key terms, open issues, and commitments made.

sections.title: Call Overview
sections.instruction: Summarize the purpose of the call — what contract or agreement is being negotiated, what stage the negotiation is at, and what the primary objectives were for this session.

sections.title: Participants
sections.instruction: List all parties on the call, their organization, and their role (e.g., vendor account executive, legal counsel, procurement lead, decision maker).

sections.title: Contract / Agreement Summary
sections.instruction: Summarize the contract being discussed — what it covers, the term length, total value or pricing structure, and any key service components.

sections.title: Terms Discussed
sections.instruction: Capture each term or clause that was discussed, the current proposed language, and the outcome of the discussion.

sections.title: Points of Agreement
sections.instruction: List all terms, conditions, or provisions that both parties agreed to during this call.

sections.title: Open Issues & Sticking Points
sections.instruction: List unresolved issues, terms still under negotiation, or areas where the parties did not reach agreement. Note each party's position where applicable.

sections.title: Commitments Made
sections.instruction: List any specific commitments, concessions, or assurances made by either party during the call.

sections.title: Next Steps
sections.instruction: List follow-up actions including revised drafts to be sent, approvals needed, legal review items, and the next scheduled call or deadline.
